The limited grievance of the petitioners in the present petition is that although the compensation amount as determined under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 was paid, but it was paid belatedly and therefore, the petitioners are entitled to interest on delayed payment of the said amount.
2.

sentences.text: the State authority and the learned counsel appearing for Respondent-CIDCO to take instructions in the matter.
The petition was directed to be listed for directions today.

3. The learned counsel appearing for Respondent Nos. 3 and 4, i.e. Officers of the CIDCO states on instructions that if a proposal is sent by the competent authority of the State with regard to the amount payable towards interest, further follow up action will be taken at the earliest possible.

4. In view of the above, the Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition) Metro Centre No. 3, Panvel, is directed to send a proposal for payment of interest on delayed payment of compensation to the petitioners under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, to Respondent Nos. 3 and 4 (CIDCO) within four weeks from today.

5. Respondent Nos. 3 and 4 shall consider the said proposal, calculate the amount payable towards interest and deposit such amount with the Respondent No. 1- Deputy Collector (Land Acquisition)
Metro Centre No. 3, Panvel, within four weeks thereafter.
6. List the petition under the same caption for directions on 8 th June 2026.
(SHREERAM V. SHIRSAT, J.) (MANISH PITALE, J.)
